messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Yet, in the middle of math I wanted to put my head down and just fall asleep.

output.original_text: Yet, in the middle of math I wanted to put my head down and just fall asleep.
output.joy: Yet, in the middle of math, I felt so relaxed that I just wanted to put my head down and blissfully drift off.
output.sadness: Yet, in the middle of math, I felt so overwhelmed that I just wanted to put my head down and fall asleep to escape it all.
output.fear: Yet, in the middle of math, I couldn't shake the feeling that I just wanted to put my head down and fall asleep, hoping nothing terrible would happen.
output.anger: Yet, in the middle of math, I was so frustrated that I wanted to slam my head down and just fall asleep in protest.
output.surprise: Yet, in the middle of math, to my shock, I found myself wanting to put my head down and just fall asleep!
output.disgust: Yet, in the middle of math, I was so fed up that I just wanted to put my head down and fall asleep, completely disgusted.
